title: 声明图与主机发现事实的对账
summary: 运行时 Registry/Graph 描述期望系统，Host Inventory 描述实际可见环境；Reconciliation 将两者对账并把缺失依赖、重复私有所有权、未认领运行时和 PATH 多版本等漂移变成结构化 issue。
principles: Declared configuration and discovered host state are separate evidence sources.
Normalize comparable identities such as filesystem paths before ownership comparison.
A declared private dependency claimed by multiple runtimes is a structural error.
A registered engine without runtime and a runtime without engine descriptor are distinct drift classes.
Discovered but unclaimed runtime candidates are evidence, not automatically adopted configuration.
Multiple PATH-visible tool versions should be surfaced instead of relying on PATH ordering.
